add_altorg_directory: add an altorg dataset directory to the NLE database by parsing xlogfiles and matching ttyrecs to games
add_nledata_directory: add an NLE data directory to the database by reading xlogfiles and inserting games and ttyrecs
assign_ttyrecs_to_games: assign a player's ttyrec recordings to their NetHack games using a timestamp-based matching algorithm
altorg_filename_to_timestamp: parse an alt.org ttyrec filename and return its UTC timestamp as a float
game_data_generator: parse an xlogfile line by line and yield tuples of game metadata for each recorded game
